title: Hormel Foods Names Joe O’Connor Group Vice President, Enterprise Performance
summary: The post Hormel Foods Names Joe O’Connor Group Vice President, Enterprise Performance appeared first on Hormel Foods .
body_markdown:
In this role, O’Connor will lead the company’s enterprise performance efforts, working across business units and functions to strengthen decision-making, improve planning processes and support long-term business performance.


“Through his leadership of Applegate and, more recently, our emerging brands business, Joe has demonstrated an ability to build strong teams, adapt to changing market conditions and deliver results,” said John Ghingo, president and chief executive officer-elect, Hormel Foods. “His enterprise perspective, strategic mindset and proven leadership make him exceptionally well suited to lead enterprise performance and help drive our long-term success.”


O’Connor most recently served as vice president, emerging brands. During his more than 20 years with Hormel Foods, he has held a variety of leadership roles and gained broad experience across sales, marketing, category management and general management.


O’Connor’s appointment is effective Oct. 26, 2026.


## About Joe O’Connor


O’Connor currently serves as vice president, emerging brands, where he oversees the company’s Applegate and Columbus Craft Meats businesses.


O’Connor joined Hormel Foods in 2006 as a sales representative in Chicago and has held leadership positions of increasing responsibility throughout the organization. Following roles in category management, customer business management and sales leadership, he joined Applegate as vice president of sales and marketing in 2020. He was named assistant vice president, emerging brands, and president of Applegate in 2022 and assumed his current role in 2025.


Prior to joining Hormel Foods, he held positions with Snyder’s of Hanover, Clemens Markets and Albert Organics.


O’Connor holds a bachelor’s degree in food marketing from Saint Joseph’s University.
